function.description: Intent API to get a list of global issues, issues for a specific device, or issue for a specific client device's MAC address.
function.name: api_issues

aiDriven.description: The issue's AI driven value: YES or NO (case insensitive) (Use only when macAddress and deviceId are not provided)

deviceId.description: Assurance UUID value of the device in the issue content

endTime.description: Ending epoch time in milliseconds of query time window

issueStatus.description: The issue's status value: ACTIVE, IGNORED, RESOLVED (case insensitive)

macAddress.description: Client's device MAC address of the issue (format xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx)

priority.description: The issue's priority value: P1, P2, P3, or P4 (case insensitive) (Use only when macAddress and deviceId are not provided)

siteId.description: Assurance UUID value of the site in the issue content

startTime.description: Starting epoch time in milliseconds of query time window

response.description: List of issues in the query time window

aiDriven.description: Whether the issue is AI driven ('Yes' or 'No')

clientMac.description: The client MAC address related to this issue

deviceId.description: The device UUID where the issue occurred

issue_occurence_count.description: Total number of instances of this issue in the query time window

last_occurence_time.description: The UTC timestamp of last occurence of this issue

siteId.description: The site UUID where the issue occurred

totalCount.description: Total number of issues in the query time window
